resources.string: Your Smart Guide to Cyber Safety
Welcome! Use this app to check suspicious messages and links, ask cyber safety questions, and learn how to stay safe online.
Check suspicious SMS, WhatsApp messages, emails, etc.
Never share OTPs, PINs or passwords with anyone.
Banks never ask for your details over messages or calls.
Think before you click unknown links.
Use strong, different passwords for every account.

Cyber AI Guide is a cybersecurity awareness app for students and beginners. The Message Checker and URL Checker use simple rule-based checks on your device — they are for awareness only and cannot guarantee that a message or website is safe. Your text is never stored or sent anywhere.\n\nDeveloped by Astha Nayi
Paste a suspicious message and check for possible scam or phishing signs.
Enter or paste a website URL to check for warning signs.
Note: the link is never opened by this app.
That does not look like a website address.

This is an awareness check, not a guarantee. Scammers change their tricks often, so always use your own judgement.
Hi! I\'m your Cyber AI Guide. Ask me anything about online safety — for example: \"What is phishing?\" or \"How can I protect my Instagram account?\"
Currently in demo mode: my answers come from a built-in offline knowledge base. A real AI API can be connected later without changing the app code.
Ten simple lessons to help you stay safe online. Reading them all only takes a few minutes.
